name: Das xBoot 2wei!

features.name: Torpedo Builder
features.description: Triggered by a full boat in the binocular view.

review:
Das xBoot 2wei! is a submarine sequel with a variable six-reel grid that starts at 2-3-4-4-3-2 and can grow. Four-row xNudge Wilds gain +1 per nudge, xWays on reels 2 and 5 reveal symbol stacks, and xBomb wilds explode every symbol that isn't part of a win.

The Torpedo Builder triggers when a full boat appears in the binocular view above reels 5 and 6. The top mode is Silent Hunter Spins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 59,999x ceiling. Very busy and very swingy.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
